name: duoday-video
description: Vídeo de apresentação do DuoDay (Remotion). Separado do app.

scripts.render:principal: remotion render src/index.ts Principal out/duoday-principal-16x9.mp4 && ./finalize.sh out/duoday-principal-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render src/index.ts Vertical out/duoday-vertical-9x16.mp4 && ./finalize.sh out/duoday-vertical-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:completo: remotion render src/index.ts Completo out/duoday-demonstracao-completa-16x9.mp4 && ./finalize.sh out/duoday-demonstracao-completa-16x9.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:principal && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:completo
